scientific_integrity: All-size identity proved by generating-function differentiation and an explicit ratio inequality; exact finite numerical checks are corroborating rather than proof.
scientific_limitations: Uniform rooted ordered plane trees only; covariance, not stochastic ordering; implicit priority coverage by more general earlier tree enumerators is possible. Independent validation has not been performed.
title: Negative root-degree/depth covariance in uniform Catalan trees
